description: This file defines a Java interface 'MessagesTopicPathBuilder' used for building message topic paths within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends another interface 'TopicPathBuildable' and provides a method to set a custom subject for a message topic, facilitating a fluent API style for constructing topics.

classes.name: MessagesTopicPathBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building message topic paths with an ability to set a custom subject, extending 'TopicPathBuildable'.

methods.name: subject
methods.description: Sets a custom subject on the message topic path, used if there is no predefined Action, returning the builder for method chaining.
